Let me analyze the opponent's team and my options.

Opponent's team: Corviknight, Toxapex, Gholdengo, Annihilape, Dragapult, Kingambit

- Gholdengo: Good as Gold (immune to status), Steel/Ghost typing
- Kingambit: Dark/Steel, can set up Swords Dance
- Toxapex: Very bulky Poison/Water wall
- Annihilape: Fighting/Ghost, can be dangerous
- Corviknight: Steel/Flying wall

My options:
- Garchomp: Fast Dragon/Ground physical attacker with Swords Dance
- Hydreigon: Special attacker, Dark/Dragon, Life Orb
- Kingambit: Dark/Steel physical, Swords Dance, priority Sucker Punch
- Rotom-Wash: Electric/Water, Will-O-Wisp, VoltSwitch, bulky
- Corviknight: Steel/Flying wall with Roost, Defog
- Clefable: Fairy with Calm Mind, Moonlight, Unaware

Let me think about what works well against their team:

1. Garchomp - Good against Kingambit (neutral), Corviknight (super effective Ground), Toxapex (neutral), Annihilape (super effective Dragon). Outspeeds most things except Dragapult. Swords Dance is a win condition.

2. Hydreigon - Good against Gholdengo (super effective Dark), Annihilape (super effective Dragon), Dragapult (super effective Dragon). But weak to Fighting (Annihilape) and Fairy.

3. Kingambit - Good against Gholdengo (super effective Dark), Annihilape (super effective Dark). But weak to Fighting (Annihilape) and Ground (Garchomp).

4. Rotom-Wash - Good against Corviknight (super effective Electric), Toxapex (resists Poison, neutral Water), Dragapult (resists Dragon). Will-O-Wisp helps against physical attackers.

5. Clefable - Good against Kingambit (super effective Fairy), Annihilape (resists Fighting). Calm Mind setup. Unaware ignores stat boosts.

6. Corviknight - Good against Kingambit (resists Dark, neutral Steel), Annihilape (resists Fighting). But weak to Fire and Ground.

Against their team composition:
- Dragapult is the biggest speed threat - needs something to handle it
- Toxapex is a wall - needs something to break through
- Gholdengo is immune to status - needs direct damage

I think a good core would be:
- Garchomp: Can handle Corviknight, Toxapex (neutral), and set up Swords Dance. Stone Edge for Dragapult.
- Hydreigon: Handles Gholdengo, Annihilape, Dragapult with super effective moves. Earth Power for Toxapex.
- Rotom-Wash: Handles Corviknight, Toxapex (walls it), Dragapult (resists Dragon), and provides Will-O-Wisp support.

Actually, let me reconsider. Clefable with Calm Mind + Unaware could be a great win condition against Kingambit and Annihilape. But it's slow and vulnerable to Gholdengo (Shadow Ball) and Toxapex.

- Annihilape (setup sweeper)

- Hydreigon handles Gholdengo/Annihilape/Dragapult with super effective moves

I'll go with Garchomp, Hydreigon, Clefable:
